definition: An alphabet is a set of written symbols used to represent the sounds of a language, though the word is sometimes used more loosely for symbol systems that also stand for things rather than sounds. The term originally referred to the Greek series of letters named from alpha and beta, and was later extended to similar writing systems in other languages.
